categories_read.name: categories_read
categories_read.using: tenant_id is null or tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid

categories_nature_check.name: categories_nature_check
categories_nature_check.value: nature is null or nature in ('fixed', 'variable')

users_same_tenant_select.name: users_same_tenant_select
users_same_tenant_select.using:
exists (
        select 1 from memberships m
        where m.user_id = users.id and m.tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid
      )
